emergency.title: Emergency Contacts
emergency.description: There are multiple pharmacies available in Uvita within a 15-minute radius and many offer extended hours and basic medical assistance.

contacts.title: Immediate Emergency (24/7 – First Call)
contacts.subtitle: In remote areas such as Ojochal, response times may vary. If possible, proceed to the nearest clinic while awaiting assistance.

activities.title: Tandem Paragliding — Zion
activities.description: 15–20 minute tandem flight with 15 years of operating experience. Licensed and fully insured pilots. Departs from Dominical.

activities.title: Corcovado + Marine Experience
activities.description: Premium Corcovado and marine operator with a unique whale tour led by a marine biologist using hydrophone listening. Includes Tapir Trail private reserve.
features: Whale tour with marine biologist + hydrophone

activities.title: Nature & Wildlife Jungle Experiences
activities.description: Multi-category nature reserve with wildlife tours, birdwatching, night tours, and the premium Chilamate experience. 330-hectare private reserve.
features: Night tour: reptiles, frogs, nocturnal animals

activities.title: Jungle ATV with Cultural Experience
activities.description: 5-hour ATV or side-by-side experience combining jungle riding with a visit to a local Costa Rican family, coffee harvesting, snacks buffet, and bilingual guide.
features: Visit to local CR family + coffee demo

activities.title: Corcovado National Park — Sirena & San Pedrillo
activities.description: Full-service nature operator with access to the top ranger stations in Corcovado. High wildlife probability: monkeys, sloths, tapirs, birds. Overnight expeditions available.
features: Sirena + San Pedrillo ranger station access
Boat transport + park fees + meals included

activities.title: ATV & Side-by-Side Jungle Adventure
activities.description: Private facility ATV experience through forests, rivers, and hills with a coffee farm visit. Best for experienced riders seeking a premium feel.

activities.title: Tandem Paragliding — Dominical & Rivas
activities.description: 20–30 minute tandem flight (longer than competitors) with certified instructor. Family-run, 14 years experience. English spoken. Payment collected after the activity.

activities.title: Full-Day Waterfall Tour
activities.description: Full-day guided tour visiting 3 different waterfalls, beach stop, and lunch at a restaurant with ocean view. Transportation from office included.

activities.title: Vuelo del Tucán Canopy
activities.description: 7 zip lines through a 330-hectare private nature reserve. Small groups of 2–8 people, with ecological walk and high wildlife spotting potential.
features: Multiple daily schedules: 8 AM, 11 AM, 2 PM

activities.title: Canyoning & Waterfall Rappelling
activities.description: Multiple waterfall rappels with jungle hiking and natural pool interaction. A complete package for adventure-seekers — beginners welcome.
features: Helmet, harness, full safety gear included

activities.title: Osa Canopy Tour
activities.description: 7 zip lines including a 1.1 km longest line, 2–3 rappels, and 2 hanging bridges. Small to medium groups, scenic mountain setting.

activities.title: Zipline + Waterfalls Adventure Combo
activities.description: Multi-activity adventure combining 5 zip lines, tree rappelling, monkey drop into water, natural pool, and waterfall slide. Local lunch included.

casaMango.name: Casa Mango
casaMango.description: Villa Mango also includes a game room for entertainment, a spacious yoga deck surrounded by nature, and open social areas that invite guests to unwind and enjoy time together.
casaMango.about:
Casa Mango is an exclusive escape designed for comfort, space, and connection. Its private setting and relaxed atmosphere make it the perfect destination for groups and families seeking to share unforgettable moments in a refined and natural environment.

Villa Mango also includes a game room for entertainment, a spacious yoga deck surrounded by nature, and open social areas that invite guests to unwind and enjoy time together. It's an ideal retreat for experiencing Costa Rica in a refined yet natural way.

goodToKnow.title: Our villas are located in a pristine mountain environment, and part of the magic of staying here comes with a few things worth keeping in mind to ensure a comfortable experience.

meshDoors.title: Mesh Doors and Windows
meshDoors.description: Our villas are equipped with mesh screens on doors and windows to keep insects out. We kindly ask that you keep them closed at all times, especially in the evenings, to ensure a comfortable and bug-free stay.

powerOutages.title: Power Outages
powerOutages.description: Due to our remote mountain location, occasional brief power outages may occur. We recommend keeping your phone charged and having a flashlight handy, both of which are available at the villa.

transportation.title: Transportation
transportation.description: A 4x4 vehicle is highly recommended to access the villa and surrounding areas safely and comfortably.

foodStorage.title: Food Storage
foodStorage.description: We ask that all food be stored in the refrigerator or in sealed containers when not in use. Leaving food out in the kitchen or common areas can attract wildlife, which is a natural part of our mountain ecosystem but best admired from a distance.

nighttimeLighting.title: Nighttime Lighting
nighttimeLighting.description: We provide exterior lighting along pathways for your safety. Please keep in mind that lights left on unnecessarily at night tend to attract insects, so we suggest turning off any lights in rooms or terraces that are not in use, and keeping doors and windows closed.
